headline: UK Commits £100 Million to 'World First' AI Biosecurity Lab
summary: The UK Chancellor will unveil a £100 million investment in a new AI Biosecurity Lab during Wednesday's Budget to strengthen sovereign defense and bioscience capabilities.
why: Targeted government capital expenditure in biotechnology and AI research supports domestic scientific infrastructure and fosters public-private life sciences partnerships.

impacts.name: Biotechnology
impacts.why: Direct state spending of £100 million stimulates UK biosecurity and AI research funding.
